title: RoleCall Sync
description: The prep you already wrote on RoleCall, waiting in Foundry when you sit down to run. Every scene becomes a Journal Entry — read-aloud text, your GM notes, and a page for each NPC, encounter, loot cache and magic item — plus your campaign lore notes, filed under one RoleCall folder. Entries are split into player-safe pages and GM-only ones, so handing the party a scene mid-session shows them the boxed text and nothing behind it. Does not import maps: a RoleCall scene is narrative prep, not a battlemap, and carries no map art. Requires a free account at https://rolecall.games.
